name: templar
brief: Templar: RED surcoat with WHITE cross; steel metal armor with plate detail on chest (pechera), pauldrons, arm plates, greaves, metal gauntlets and sabatons. Not flat sepia cloth — metal must read as armor.

plan.overall_look: Templar knight: closed steel great helm with rivets/visor detail; red surcoat (#B22222) with bold white Templar cross; steel breastplate pechera with plate seams over/under surcoat chest; steel pauldrons with rim; arm plate segments over mail-toned steel; metal gauntlets; thigh/shin plate sections; steel sabatons. Metal palette: highlight #D0D0D8, mid #9A9AA8, shade #5A5A68.

upper_arm_far.visual_notes: Steel upper-arm plate + bulky pauldron #9A9AA8 with rim #5A5A68 and highlight.

lower_arm_far.visual_notes: Steel forearm plate #9A9AA8 + metal gauntlet/hand #9A9AA8 with darker knuckle band #5A5A68.

upper_leg_far.visual_notes: Red surcoat skirt top #B22222 + steel thigh plate section mid-thigh #9A9AA8.

lower_leg_far.visual_notes: Steel greave plate strip with edge line; steel sabaton foot #9A9AA8 / #5A5A68.

torso.visual_notes: Red surcoat #B22222 full torso; white Templar cross #F0F0F0 centered; steel pechera/breastplate band across upper chest with horizontal plate seam and darker edges; dark belt optional thin.

head.visual_notes: Steel great helm #9A9AA8 with darker rim #5A5A68, highlight top #D0D0D8, eye slit near-black, rivet dots, slight overhang.

upper_arm_near.visual_notes: Steel pauldron + upper-arm plate, mirror far.

lower_arm_near.visual_notes: Steel forearm plate + metal gauntlet, match far.

upper_leg_near.visual_notes: Red skirt + steel thigh plate, match far.

lower_leg_near.visual_notes: Steel greave + steel sabaton, match far.

user_facing_summary:
Outfit plan for `templar`
Brief: Templar: RED surcoat with WHITE cross; steel metal armor with plate detail on chest (pechera), pauldrons, arm plates, greaves, metal gauntlets and sabatons. Not flat sepia cloth — metal must read as armor.

Overall look:
Templar knight: closed steel great helm with rivets/visor detail; red surcoat (#B22222) with bold white Templar cross; steel breastplate pechera with plate seams over/under surcoat chest; steel pauldrons with rim; arm plate segments over mail-toned steel; metal gauntlets; thigh/shin plate sections; steel sabatons. Metal palette: highlight #D0D0D8, mid #9A9AA8, shade #5A5A68.

Design layers (same 10 names as base/layers/):
  - upper_arm_far: paint on [upper_arm_far] (pose parent=upper_arm_far) — Steel upper-arm plate + bulky pauldron #9A9AA8 with rim #5A5A68 and highlight.
  - lower_arm_far: paint on [lower_arm_far, hand_far] (pose parent=lower_arm_far) — Steel forearm plate #9A9AA8 + metal gauntlet/hand #9A9AA8 with darker knuckle band #5A5A68.
  - upper_leg_far: paint on [upper_leg_far] (pose parent=upper_leg_far) — Red surcoat skirt top #B22222 + steel thigh plate section mid-thigh #9A9AA8.
  - lower_leg_far: paint on [lower_leg_far, foot_far] (pose parent=lower_leg_far) — Steel greave plate strip with edge line; steel sabaton foot #9A9AA8 / #5A5A68.
  - torso: paint on [torso] (pose parent=torso) — Red surcoat #B22222 full torso; white Templar cross #F0F0F0 centered; steel pechera/breastplate band across upper chest with horizontal plate seam and darker edges; dark belt optional thin.
  - head: paint on [head] (pose parent=head) — Steel great helm #9A9AA8 with darker rim #5A5A68, highlight top #D0D0D8, eye slit near-black, rivet dots, slight overhang.
  - upper_arm_near: paint on [upper_arm_near] (pose parent=upper_arm_near) — Steel pauldron + upper-arm plate, mirror far.
  - lower_arm_near: paint on [lower_arm_near, hand_near] (pose parent=lower_arm_near) — Steel forearm plate + metal gauntlet, match far.
  - upper_leg_near: paint on [upper_leg_near] (pose parent=upper_leg_near) — Red skirt + steel thigh plate, match far.
  - lower_leg_near: paint on [lower_leg_near, foot_near] (pose parent=lower_leg_near) — Steel greave + steel sabaton, match far.

Painting rule: for each active export layer, prepare_outfit_slot_reference then paint ONLY via MCP tools onto design/layers/<layer>.png (fill_parts_on_slot for that layer's body_parts silhouette; fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels for details). FORBIDDEN: Shell/PIL scripts or external image generators. Each design file rigid-rotates 1:1 with its body part (no multi-parent split). Clothing MAY overhang the body silhouette — body underlay is alignment reference, not a clip mask; keep proportions sensible. If this matches, say OK and paint layers; otherwise revise the plan.
